# Three UPSes on one upsd: one on mains and charging (no description, no
# realpower), one needing a new battery, and one whose driver lost the
# UPS. Written from the protocol docs; not recorded.
> VER
< Network UPS Tools upsd 2.8.2 - https://www.networkupstools.org/
> LIST UPS
< BEGIN LIST UPS
< UPS desk "Unavailable"
< UPS closet "Closet \"network\" UPS"
< UPS garage "Garage UPS"
< END LIST UPS
> LIST VAR desk
< BEGIN LIST VAR desk
< VAR desk battery.charge "64"
< VAR desk battery.runtime "1500"
< VAR desk device.mfr "American Power Conversion"
< VAR desk device.model "Back-UPS ES 700G"
< VAR desk driver.name "usbhid-ups"
< VAR desk input.voltage "121.0"
< VAR desk input.voltage.nominal "120"
< VAR desk ups.load "9"
< VAR desk ups.realpower.nominal "405"
< VAR desk ups.status "OL CHRG"
< END LIST VAR desk
> LIST VAR closet
< BEGIN LIST VAR closet
< VAR closet battery.charge "100"
< VAR closet battery.runtime "540"
< VAR closet device.model "Smart-UPS 750"
< VAR closet driver.name "apcsmart"
< VAR closet input.voltage "229.0"
< VAR closet ups.load "41"
< VAR closet ups.status "OL RB"
< END LIST VAR closet
> LIST VAR garage
< ERR DATA-STALE
